episodes.title: Independence
episodes.summary: The Ingalls family trades Wisconsin's woods for the wide-open plains of Kansas, where their new life brings both breathtaking beauty and genuine danger.

episodes.title: The House on the Prairie
episodes.summary: A neighbor steps up to help the Ingalls build their new home, but their growing bond is threatened by the shadows of his past — and Caroline's.

episodes.title: News of the World
episodes.summary: As the house on the prairie approaches completion, a troubling encounter makes the family reconsider their decision to settle in Independence.

episodes.title: Life Let Us Cherish
episodes.summary: With fever gripping the town and medicine in short supply, the Ingalls face their most perilous challenge yet.

episodes.title: A Circle of Blue Sky
episodes.summary: Caroline and the girls struggle to fit in at a ladies' event. Charles sets out to find the family's missing horses — and clear an innocent man's name.

episodes.title: Peace on Earth
episodes.summary: Snowed in and far from family, the Ingalls try to find a little cheer on a quiet Christmas Eve. But Santa has a surprise or two in store.

episodes.title: A Softer Note in the Sound of the Wind
episodes.summary: The Osage gather for a pivotal tribal council, with the fate of the land — and Laura's friendship with Good Eagle — in the balance.

episodes.title: This Is Now
episodes.summary: After catching wind of their parents' debts, Laura and Mary resolve to save the day by winning prize money at the town's first Founder's Day.
